suppress.notes: CVE-2026-47884: SSRF/RCE through XsltView with a "/**" view mapping. No service uses XsltView or any view resolution; every controller returns JSON (@RestController). Also accepted in .trivyignore (2026-10-08).
CVE-2026-47885: WebFlux PartEventHttpMessageReader ignores maxPartSize when maxInMemorySize is -1. WebFlux is not on any service's classpath as a server stack.

CVE-2026-47886: DoS when user-supplied SpEL uses the power operator with BigDecimal. No code parses SpEL from request data (no SpelExpressionParser in src/main); the only SpEL is fixed annotation/config expressions written by developers.
CVE-2026-47888: memory leak in Spring RSocket via a malformed SETUP frame. No service uses RSocket.
CVE-2026-47889: WebFlux on the Jetty 12 Core adapter drops the SameSite cookie attribute. Services run Spring MVC on Tomcat; no WebFlux, no Jetty.
CVE-2026-47891: WebFlux with the Aalto XML parser ignores maxInMemorySize. No WebFlux, no XML request bodies, Aalto is not on the classpath.
CVE-2026-47892: header predicate bypass on pre-flight requests for WebFlux functional endpoints. No WebFlux and no RouterFunction endpoints; all controllers are annotated.
CVE-2026-47893: WebFlux WebSocket handshake exposes request headers in an exception reason. No WebFlux and no WebSocket endpoints.

CVE-2026-59282: DoS when data binding applies user-supplied property paths onto a target object. No handler binds request parameters onto objects (no @ModelAttribute, no implicit form-object parameters, no WebDataBinder customisation); request payloads are JSON read by Jackson through @RequestBody, and query parameters are bound to scalar @RequestParam values only.

CVE-2026-59283: SimpleEvaluationContext guard bypass when the SpEL compiler is active. No code evaluates SpEL from user input and the SpEL compiler is not enabled (spring.expression.compiler.mode is unset).

CVE-2026-59313: SSE stream corruption in the functional web framework (RouterFunction / ServerResponse.sse). The coach stream uses an annotated controller returning SseEmitter, not the functional framework.
CVE-2026-41707: replay through cache eviction in DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory. The resource servers validate plain bearer JWTs; DPoP-bound tokens are not configured anywhere.
CVE-2026-47841: WebAuthn user-verification bypass with a distributed session store. No service enables WebAuthn (passkeys); sessions are stateless JWT.
CVE-2026-59270: the embedded UnboundID LDAP test server (UnboundIdContainer) registers an admin credential and binds to all interfaces. No service uses LDAP, and UnboundID is not on the classpath.

CVE-2026-53914: false positive. The CVE is unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build-cache metadata in the Kotlin compiler / build tooling. It is matched only through the broad cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin CPE; the runtime kotlin-stdlib and kotlin-reflect jars contain no build-cache code, and this project does not compile Kotlin. Reviewed 2026-10-10.
